summary: Haleon plc, through its subsidiary Haleon US Capital LLC, launched and priced a $2 billion three-tranche SEC-registered senior notes offering on 12 August 2026, settling 21 August 2026. Tranches: $600M 4.625% notes due 2029, $600M 4.875% notes due 2031, and $800M 5.375% notes due 2036, fully guaranteed by Haleon. Proceeds will fund a concurrent tender offer for its $1.999B 3.375% notes due March 2027. Joint book-runners: Barclays, BofA, Deutsche Bank, Goldman Sachs, Mizuho. This is an ordinary debt issuance/refinancing, not a special situation; category None.
